notes.title: Notes
notes.description: What you and your agents keep: decisions, explanations, findings and links.
notes.newDescription: A title, then the text in Markdown. Without a project it is a general note.
notes.emptyHint: Write one with New note, or ask an agent to write down what it found.
notes.noMatchHint: Change the filters or clear them.
notes.markdownHint: Markdown. Images show as links; HTML shows as text.
notes.conflictTitle: The note changed while you were typing
notes.conflictBody: Your text is still here. Reload to see the new text and drop yours, or save again to put yours over it: the text you replace stays as a version.
notes.deleteMessage: The note and all its versions are deleted. This cannot be undone.
notes.deleteChanged: The note changed since you opened it. Look at the new text, then delete it again.
notes.restoreUnsaved: Save or discard your changes first.
notes.restoreChanged: The note changed meanwhile. Look at the versions again.
notes.restoreProjectGone: The project of that version was deleted. Move the note instead.
notes.projectEmpty: No notes in this project yet.
notes.projectEmptyHint: Notes keep what is worth finding again about the project.

errors.network: Mikud did not answer. Check the connection
errors.refreshFailed: Could not update. Showing what was loaded last.
errors.secretSuspected: This text looks like it holds a secret (a token, key or server detail). Remove it and try again.

code.secret_suspected: The text looks like it holds a secret
code.not_top_level: Only top-level threads can be linked
code.conflict: It conflicts with the current state
code.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute
code.telegram_failed: Telegram did not take the message
code.telegram_uncertain: Telegram gave no clear answer; the message may have been sent

copy.needsHttps: Copying needs HTTPS. Select the text and copy it yourself.

leaveMessage.one: You have 1 unsaved change. Leaving drops it.
leaveMessage.other: You have {count} unsaved changes. Leaving drops them.

unsaved.discardMessage: What you typed in this window is not saved.

sync.title: Last complete sync of T3 threads
sync.staleTitle: The T3 sync is out of date
sync.staleBody: Items and statuses may have changed since the last successful sync, at
sync.neverTitle: T3 has not been synced yet
sync.neverBody: Items appear once the sync tool on your PC runs for the first time.
sync.partialBody: A later sync could not read every project, at

bell.title: Needs you
bell.failed: Could not check what needs you.
bell.someFailed: The last check failed. This is what it showed before.
bell.allClearHint: Items waiting on you, stage proposals and critical security findings appear here.

proposal.title: Proposed stage: {stage}
proposal.rejected: The stage proposal for {project} was rejected

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.placeholder: An idea, a task, something to check
quickAdd.hint: The first line is the title. Ctrl+Enter adds it.

morning.title: Overview
morning.description: What waits on you, what changed since your last visit, and whether anything in security is critical.

kpiWaitingHint.one: 1 needs a decision or a test
kpiWaitingHint.other: {count} need a decision or a test

morning.waitingEmptyHint: Items an agent hands to you and stage proposals appear here.
morning.newEmpty: Nothing new since your last visit.
morning.newEmptyHint: Items created or changed after your last visit appear here.
morning.updatesEmpty: No agent updates since your last visit.
morning.updatesEmptyHint: Comments and status changes by agents and the sync appear here, by project.
morning.projectsEmptyHint: A project shows here once it has an open item.

security.rule: Critical findings count in every project; high ones only in projects at stage Production.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Every project, its stage, its near goal and where it stands.
projects.emptyHint: Projects arrive from T3 with the sync, or add one with New project.
projects.newHint: Projects from T3 arrive by themselves; add one here for work outside T3.
projects.name: Name

project.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted. All projects are on the Projects page.
project.stageHint: Only you set the stage. Agents propose one, and the proposal waits for you.
project.stageBack: {name} is back at its previous stage
project.noGoalHint: A goal shows how many of its items are done.
project.goalHint: One short sentence. Items you link to it count toward its progress.
project.goalReplaceHint: A new text closes the current goal; its items keep their link to it.
project.noWhereHint: Agents keep this line current; you can change it too.
project.whereHint: One or two sentences on where the project stands.
project.noItemsHint: Items from T3 threads, agents and quick add appear here.
project.securityEmpty: No security data for this project.
project.securityEmptyHint: The sync brings GitHub alerts for projects with a repository.
project.deleteHint: Deleting cannot be undone. The sync will not create the project again.

deleteHintItems.one: It has 1 open item. Move or delete its items first.
deleteHintItems.other: It has {count} open items. Move or delete its items first.

deleteItems.one: It still has 1 item; the server refuses while a project has items.
deleteItems.other: It still has {count} items; the server refuses while a project has items.

project.deleteForever: The sync will not create it again. This cannot be undone.
project.deleteConflict: it still has items or notes. Move or delete them first

item.title: Item
item.notFoundHint: It was deleted. Its history stays in Activity.
item.goalUnlinked: {title} no longer counts toward the goal
item.conflictBody: Your text is kept. Save again to replace the change with it, or reload to see the item as it is now.
item.deleteMessage: Its comments and thread links go with it, and the sync will not create it again for those threads. This cannot be undone.

toast.versionConflict: {title} changed meanwhile. It was reloaded; try again.

inboxPage.description: Quick captures without a project. Give each a project and a type.
inboxPage.emptyHint: Quick add without a project, the Telegram bot and agents put notes here.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Closed items: done and not relevant, most recently closed first.
archive.emptyHint: Items marked done or not relevant move here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Every change, by you, agents, the sync and the bot, newest first.
activity.failed: Could not load the activity log
activity.emptyHint: Every change to items, projects and settings is recorded here.
activity.noMatchHint: Change the filters or clear them.

action.note_restore: restored a version of the note
action.account_password_reset: reset the password on the server
action.session_end: was signed out by the session clock
action.session_connect: gave mikud connect its short session

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How the board writes dates, who may sign in or connect, how Telegram reaches you, and how the sync is doing.

general.title: General
general.hint: The board's language, how it writes dates and times, how long closed items stay in the overview, and how long a browser stays signed in.

agents.title: Agent access
agents.hint: Agents and the sync connect with mikud connect: you approve each one in the browser, and it gets its own key with a name and an end date. A key keeps working after you sign out; disconnect it here when a machine is lost or a key leaks.

secret-check.title: Secret check
secret-check.hint: Text from agents and the Telegram bot is refused when it looks like a secret: tokens, keys, passwords, addresses, and host names under the domains below.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.hint: The bot saves what you send it under the inbox, and sends the morning message at 08:00. It serves only your chat. Changes apply when you save, without a restart.

status.title: Status
status.hint: The last T3 sync and when security data came in. Read only: the sync runs on your PC.

suppressions.title: Suppressions
suppressions.hint: Threads and T3 projects whose item or project you deleted. The sync never recreates them.

settings.languageHint: The board and the Telegram morning message. Default: Hebrew.
settings.dateFormatHint: How dates are written everywhere. Default: DD/MM/YYYY.
settings.timeZoneHint: Every time on the board is in this zone.
settings.closedDaysHint: Days a done or not relevant item stays in the overview before it is only in the archive. Default: 7.
settings.telegramTestHint: Sends today's morning message to your Telegram chat now. The 08:00 message still goes out.
settings.telegramTestSent: The test morning message was sent
settings.telegramTestSentUnrecorded: The test morning message was sent, but it could not be recorded in the activity log
settings.telegramTestRefused: Telegram did not take the test message. Check the bot token and the chat ID, then try again.
settings.telegramTestUncertain: Telegram gave no clear answer, so the test message may have been sent. Check the chat before you send it again.
settings.telegramTestFailed: Could not send the test message: {reason}
settings.telegramFailed: Could not read the Telegram status

session.idleDays: Sign out after this long without Mikud open
session.idleDaysHint: Days. Opening Mikud, or coming back to its tab, keeps a browser signed in. A shorter value does not shorten browsers already signed in; use Sign out everywhere for that. Default: 30.
session.shortened: Settings saved. Browsers already signed in keep their time; sign out everywhere to apply the shorter length now.

env.tooltip: An environment variable sets this; change it there
env.note: Set by the environment variable {variable}. Change it there and restart Mikud.
env.refused: Not saved: an environment variable sets this setting. Change it there and restart Mikud.

suppressions.emptyHint: Deleting an item with linked threads, or a project from T3, adds it here.
suppressions.removeMessage: The next sync may create its item or project again.
suppressions.removeFailed: Could not remove the suppression of {label}: {reason}

removeAllMessage.one: Remove 1 suppression? The next sync may create its item or project again.
removeAllMessage.other: Remove {count} suppressions? The next sync may create their items and projects again.

removeAllFailed.one: 1 suppression could not be removed. Try again in a moment.
removeAllFailed.other: {count} suppressions could not be removed. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.hint: The address may be old or mistyped.

telegram.help: Send me any text and I will save it in Mikud, under {inbox}. Every morning, Sunday to Friday at 08:00, I send you what is waiting on you.
telegram.refusedSecret: Nothing was saved: the text looks like it holds a secret (a password, token, key or server address). Remove it and send it again.
telegram.onlyText: I save text messages only. Nothing was saved.
telegram.signInCode:
Your Mikud sign-in code: {code}
It works once, for a few minutes. If you are not signing in right now, change your password in Mikud.

morning.allClear: Nothing is waiting on you today.

auth.usernameHint: {min} to {max} letters, digits, underscores or dots. A dot cannot be first, last or next to another dot.
auth.codeHint: The 6 digits your authenticator app shows for Mikud. They change every 30 seconds.
auth.recovery: Forgot the password? On the server, run this. Then sign in with your authenticator or a backup code:

error.network: Mikud did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.wrongPassword: The username or password is not right.
error.wrongCode: That code is not right. Enter the code your app shows now.
error.codeExpired: The sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
error.server: The server failed. Try again in a moment.
error.usernameInvalid: Use {min} to {max} letters, digits, underscores or dots, without spaces. A dot cannot be first, last or next to another dot.
error.passwordShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
error.passwordLong: The password can have at most {max} characters.
error.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
error.backupFormat: Enter a backup code as you saved it.
error.accountLocked: Too many wrong codes. Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.

auth.backupCodeHint: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-factor. Each code works once.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to Mikud with your username and password.
login.codeDescription: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Mikud.
login.backupDescription: Enter one of the backup codes you saved.
login.otpDescription: Mikud sends a sign-in code to your Telegram chat.
login.otpHint: The 6 digits Mikud sent to your Telegram chat.
login.useOtp: Send a code to Telegram instead

setup.title: Welcome to Mikud
setup.description: Create the owner account. Two-factor authentication is set up next and is required.
setup.alreadySetUp: Mikud already has its owner. Sign in instead.
setup.totpDescription: Required. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app such as 1Password, Aegis or Google Authenticator.
setup.confirmPasswordHint: Needed once to start the setup.
setup.qrAlt: QR code to add Mikud to an authenticator app
setup.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
setup.enterCode: Then enter the code the app shows:
setup.codesDescription: Two-factor is on, and every other browser was signed out. Without these codes, losing the authenticator app locks you out.
setup.signOutOthersFailed: Two-factor is on, but signing out the other browsers failed. Try again, so no browser stays signed in with the password alone.

account.title: Account
account.description: The browsers signed in to your account, your password, two-factor authentication and the way back in. Each action here takes effect at once.
account.sessionsHint: Each browser where you are signed in, and when it is signed out unless you open Mikud there again.
account.endOthersMessage: Every browser except this one must sign in again.
account.endOthersDone: The other browsers were signed out
account.endAllMessage: Every browser, this one included, must sign in again. Do this after restoring a backup or when a device is lost.
account.endFailed: Could not sign out the browsers: {reason}
account.passwordHint: Other browsers are signed out; this one stays signed in.
account.changed: Password changed. The other browsers were signed out.
account.wrongCurrent: The current password is not right.
account.recoveryHint: Forgot the password? On the server, this prints a new one once and signs out every browser; two-factor stays. Without the authenticator, the backup codes you saved are the only way in.
account.newCodesHint: Enter your password. The backup codes you saved before stop working.
account.newAuthenticatorHint: Enter your password. Two-factor is turned off, and Mikud takes you straight to setting up the new app. Until you finish, Mikud stays closed.
account.newAuthenticatorSubmit: Turn off and set up again
account.connectSessionHint: A short session for one agent approval; it normally ends within seconds.
account.endOneMessage: That session ends at once and has to sign in again.
account.codesHint: New codes replace the ones you saved; the old ones stop working.
account.authenticatorHint: A new authenticator app replaces the current one. Finish setting it up right away.
account.recoveryRow: Reset the password on the server

backupCodes.hint: These {count} backup codes let you in without the authenticator app, once each. Mikud shows them only now. Keep them somewhere safe, apart from this device.
backupCodes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Download them or write them down.
backupCodes.fileHeading: Mikud backup codes. Each code signs in once without the authenticator app.

agentKeys.howHint: Run the command in the Mikud checkout on your computer. It opens Mikud to approve the agent; the key never shows on this page.
agentKeys.howOptions: {name} sets the name shown below and {days} how long the key works (1 to 365 days, 90 if left out). For Claude Code and Codex the command adds Mikud to the client itself; restart Codex afterwards. If the client's command is missing or fails, it prints the setup once instead, and that can stay in your shell history.
agentKeys.emptyHint: Run a command above for your agent, then approve it in the browser.
agentKeys.disconnectMessage: Its next request is refused. To use it again, connect it again from the agent.

disconnectAllMessage.one: Disconnect 1 agent? Its next request is refused. It has to connect again from its agent.
disconnectAllMessage.other: Disconnect {count} agents? Their next requests are refused. Each one has to connect again from its agent.

disconnectAllFailed.one: 1 agent is still connected. Wait a minute and try again.
disconnectAllFailed.other: {count} agents are still connected. Wait a minute and try again.

disconnectAllFailedAtLeast.one: At least 1 agent is still connected. Wait a minute and try again.
disconnectAllFailedAtLeast.other: At least {count} agents are still connected. Wait a minute and try again.

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.lead: An agent on your computer asks for its own key to Mikud.
connect.enterCode: Enter the code your agent shows.
connect.codeInvalid: The code has 8 letters and digits, as the agent shows it.
connect.client: mikud connect, run by an agent or by the sync
connect.identity: Allow only if you just started this in your agent and it shows the same code.
connect.whatKey: It gets one agent key, with the name and the days set in its command. It can read the board and keep items up to date.
connect.never: Agents can never delete items or projects, change a project's stage, or manage agents.
connect.warnTitle: Agents do not ask for another approval in Mikud.
connect.warnText: Threads and notes can contain instructions that mislead an agent. Allow only what you started, for the shortest time it needs.
connect.footnote: Disconnect this agent at any time in Settings → Agent access.
connect.closeWindow: You can close this window and go back to the agent.

reason.rate_limited: Too many attempts from this address.
reason.other: Mikud could not read the request.

connect.nothingShared: Close this window and connect the agent again. Nothing was shared with it.

failed.network: Could not save your choice. Check your connection and try again.
failed.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
failed.other: Could not save your choice. Try again.

telegramSettings.botTokenHint: From BotFather. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
telegramSettings.chatIdHint: The number of your own chat with the bot. The bot answers no other chat.
telegramSettings.unreadable: Cannot be read (its key was removed): enter it again
telegramSettings.tokenInvalid: it does not look like a token from BotFather
telegramSettings.otpHint: At sign-in, after the password, you may ask for a code in your Telegram chat instead of the authenticator app. Default: off.
telegramSettings.otpWarning: Your Telegram chat becomes a way in: whoever reads it and knows your password can sign in.
telegramSettings.otpLocked: Sign-in codes in Telegram are not available
telegramSettings.testLocked: The test message and the bot's details are not available
telegramSettings.needsTelegram: Telegram is not on yet. To turn it on, set the bot token and the chat ID in Settings → Integrations → Telegram → Bot, then save.

secretCheck.domainsHint: Your private network's domains. A host name under them in agent text is refused.
